TS-MUM-001.text: Colaba Causeway Market Category: shopping, markets, street market. Tags: shopping, souvenirs, local experience, street market, bargaining, budget_friendly, tourist_friendly, family_friendly. A long, busy street market in Colaba known for clothing, accessories, jewelry, souvenirs and handicrafts stalls; a popular spot for local and tourist shopping. Location: Shahid Bhagat Singh Road, Colaba, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-002.text: Crawford Market (Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Mandai) Category: shopping, markets, wholesale/retail market. Tags: shopping, local market, heritage building, spices, fruit, budget_friendly, tourist_friendly. A historic covered market (built in the 1860s) selling fruit, spices, household goods, pets and general merchandise; a well-known Mumbai heritage shopping landmark. Location: Lokmanya Tilak Road, near Dhobi Talao, Fort, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-003.text: Chor Bazaar Category: shopping, markets, handicrafts, antiques / flea market. Tags: shopping, antiques, vintage, local experience, bargaining, hidden gem, tourist_friendly, offbeat. One of Mumbai's oldest flea markets, known for antiques, vintage furniture, old Bollywood memorabilia, curios and secondhand goods. Location: Mutton Street, Null Bazaar area, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-004.text: Kala Ghoda Art District Category: culture, heritage, shopping, art district. Tags: culture, art, galleries, heritage walk, local experience, tourist_friendly, family_friendly. A heritage arts precinct with art galleries (e.g. Jehangir Art Gallery), museums nearby, boutique stores and street art; hosts the annual Kala Ghoda Arts Festival. Location: Kala Ghoda, Fort, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-005.text: Gateway of India Category: heritage, tourist attractions, monument. Tags: heritage, monument, photography, waterfront, must-visit, tourist_friendly, family_friendly, budget_friendly. An iconic early-20th-century archway monument overlooking the Arabian Sea, and the departure point for ferries to Elephanta Island. Location: Apollo Bunder, Colaba, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-006.text: Elephanta Caves Category: heritage, tourist attractions, religious, UNESCO World Heritage Site / rock-cut caves. Tags: heritage, UNESCO, caves, ferry trip, day trip, tourist_friendly. A UNESCO World Heritage Site of ancient rock-cut cave temples dedicated to Shiva, reached by ferry from the Gateway of India. Location: Elephanta Island (Gharapuri), Mumbai Harbour.

TS-MUM-007.text: Mohammed Ali Road Street Food Area Category: food, street_food, street food area. Tags: street food, local food, evening food walk, local experience, budget_friendly, tourist_friendly. A well-known street-food stretch with numerous stalls, especially busy and popular in the evenings and during Ramadan; offers a range of local non-vegetarian and dessert specialties. Location: Mohammed Ali Road, near Crawford Market, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-008.text: Khau Gully (CSMT area street food lane) Category: food, street_food, street food lane. Tags: street food, local food, quick bite, local experience, budget_friendly. A cluster of street-food stalls near CSMT popular with office-goers and visitors for quick local snacks. Location: Near Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Fort, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-009.text: Haji Ali Dargah Category: religious, heritage, dargah / mosque and shrine. Tags: religious, spiritual, heritage, waterfront, causeway walk, tourist_friendly, family_friendly, budget_friendly. A mosque and dargah (shrine) built on an islet off the coast of Worli, connected to the mainland by a causeway walkway that is only accessible at low tide. Location: Dargah Road, Haji Ali, Mumbai.

TS-MUM-010.text: Marine Drive Category: entertainment, tourist attractions, promenade. Tags: waterfront, sunset, evening walk, local experience, must-visit, family_friendly, tourist_friendly, budget_friendly. A 3.6 km curved boulevard along the Arabian Sea coast, nicknamed the 'Queen's Necklace' for how its streetlights look at night; popular for evening walks and sunset views. Location: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Road, Mumbai.
